'''Zapf''' was a large, six-[[Eye|eyed]], [[humanoid]] [[alien]] who was associated with [[Han Solo]], [[Qi'ra]], [[Rio Durant]], [[L3-37]], and [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]].<ref name="JLD">{{Instagram|username=jakeluntdavies|url=p/DVPInTeDdss|name=[[Jake Lunt Davies]]|date=2026-02-26|quote=Choose life. Choose a Wookiee. Choose a smooth-talking smuggler. Choose a YT-1300 Corellian freighter. Choose Zapf who never made the movie. Choose the Spice Mines, choose the Kessel Run, choose Coaxium. Trainspotting 30th Anniversary. Solo maybe 8 and a bit? Based on a random bit of line-up concept art I did for Solo #starwars #trainspotting #conceptart #lineup #soloastarwarsstory|archivefile=File:JakeDaviesZapf.png}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Choose life. Choose a Wookiee. Choose a smooth-talking smuggler. Choose a YT-1300 Corellian freighter. Choose Zapf who never made the movie. Choose the Spice Mines, choose the Kessel Run, choose Coaxium.|Jake Lunt Davies|<ref name="JLD" />}}
According to concept artist [[Jake Lunt Davies]], at one point, Zapf was a character conceptualized to be a part of ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'', but the alien never made it into movie. Davies revealed the character in an Instagram post made on [[February 26]], [[2026]].<ref name="JLD" />
